drivers.theme: Oil shock / Iran war, Brent >$100, Saudi output collapse
Hot PPI + Fed hike odds ~70%, CPI tomorrow
Barclays S&P target raise and demonstrated dip-buying resilience

parsed.rationale: Yields at yearly highs near 5% and Brent above $100 on a Saudi supply shock plus hot PPI lift Fed hike odds to ~70%, pressuring QQQ multiples, with futures lower ahead of CPI. Exceptional earnings, Barclays' target raise and proven dip-buying cushion downside. Mildly bearish near term, fading over 7 days.
